tei:div.tei:p:
Thou alone art the Lord, Thou hast made the heavens, the highest heavens, and all their host, the earth and all that are upon it, the seas and all that is in them and it is Thou who keepest all of them alive and the heavenly host bow down before Thee. Thou art the Lord God, who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name of Abraham. Thou didst find his heart faithful before Thee and conclude the covenant with him to give his
seed the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizite, the Jebusite and the Girgashite. Thou didst keep Thy word, for Thou art just. Then Thou didst see the misery of our fathers in Egypt, and hear their cry at the Sea of Reeds. Thou didst provide signs and wonders against Pharaoh and all his servants and all the people of his land for Thou didst know that they had acted arrogantly against them and Thou didst gain fame for Thyself even as on this day. And the sea didst Thou divide before them and they passed through the sea on the dry land, and their pursuers didst Thou hurl into the depths, like a stone into the mighty waters.
